Half a day at Lake Kawaguchi by bike?
The lake is about 20 km around.
So pick one stretch of shore, plus lunch.
Your train home decides which 👇

😮 Full plan 👉 https://japanbystation.com/lake-kawaguchi-half-day-cycling

🚲 Short ride (train home at 14:58)
💴 Rent Q-BIKE, Fujikyu Railway's bike share.
It's ¥1,100 an hour in the app,
never more than ¥3,300 a day.
Two hours costs ¥2,200.
🌉 Ride to Kawaguchiko Ohashi Bridge
and Ubuyagasaki. Both are Fuji viewpoints,
about 1.6 km from the station.
🍽️ You're back by about 13:00 for lunch.

🚴 North shore (train home at 16:48)
🗻 Ride to Oishi Park, about 3.4 km away.
From there, you see Fuji's whole ridge.
🍲 Lunch: hoto noodles at Hoto Fudo's north store.
Open 11:00 to 19:00, every day.
🎫 Paper day pass at the station: ¥4,400.
Sold from 10:00. Bikes back by 17:00.

🚌 No bike at all
The Red Line bus reaches Oishi Park in 27 minutes.
It runs every 15 minutes.
A day pass is ¥1,500.
The 14:12 bus gets you back at 14:39.

✅ Our take
Early train home? Ride the short stretch.
On the 16:48? Ride the north shore.
Windy, wet or rushed? Take the bus,
then walk the lakeside path.
